Name: .NET Core - Check .NET Core Framework Version
Description: Check if given .NET Core framework version (or greater) is installed.

Parameters.Name: TargetVersion
Parameters.Label: Target .NET Core framework version
Parameters.HelpText: The .NET runtime version you expect to be installed on the machine, for example 8.0 or 8.0.11. Versions are compared numerically (so 10.0 is newer than 6.0) and pre-release versions such as 10.0.0-rc.1 are supported.

Parameters.Name: Exact
Parameters.Label: Exact
Parameters.HelpText:
If you check "Exact", it means the installed .NET Core framework version MUST match target version.

Otherwise, as long as the installed .NET Core framework version is greater than or equal to target version, the check will pass.

The same rule applies to the ASP.NET Core runtime check.

Parameters.Name: CheckASPdotNETCore
Parameters.Label: Check ASP.NET Core Runtime
Parameters.HelpText: If you check "Check ASP.NET Core Runtime", this step will also check that the ASP.NET Core runtime (Microsoft.AspNetCore.App, installed by the ASP.NET Core Runtime installer or the Hosting Bundle) matching the target version is installed, using the same "Exact" rule.
